# Case 28: Clauses joined with but and semicolons, first person in the body
Skill: write-experiments
Expected gates: G-STY-ban, G-STY-voice
Language: en
Snippet:
> We compare our algorithm with four baselines; all of them use the same population size. Our algorithm reaches a 100% feasibility rate, but the baselines fail on the largest instance.
Why it fails: the house style bans semicolons and clause-joining but in author prose, and author actions take this study or the passive, with we reserved for future work.
